atomicity.rule: copy government identity and the full loaded-feature manifest inside one main-thread, two-sample frame/root identity gate
atomicity.orchestration_join_forbidden: Two independently returned command results must not be called same-frame solely because the outer orchestrator joined them.

government.flags: complete stable-name vector, unsigned UTF-8 bytewise sorted with multiplicity preserved

published_fields.effective_feature_flags: all 44 explicit booleans in frozen native index order with stable keys
published_fields.script_dlc_keys: complete runtime set in unsigned UTF-8 bytewise order

adapter.family: nullable stable adapter family from the frozen table
adapter.requirements_met: true only when every required effective feature is true

adapter_selection: Select the row only by exact runtime government stable key.
Evaluate required features only from the same observation's effective_feature_flags.
Use script_dlc_keys as corroborating product identity, never to reconstruct feature booleans.
Return unavailable_feature_mismatch when a required feature is false.
Return unadapted_runtime_government for unknown or mod-added keys and keep the observed key and flags.
Return owner_deferred_religious for theocracy_government and holy_order_government without examining faith, doctrine, tenet, fervor or holy-order mechanics.

entitlement_semantics.rule: A cached false value must not be published as not_entitled.

live_acceptance.reason: research-only package; CK3 launch and bridge implementation are out of scope
